algorithm: Walk logical entries in archive order and increment the entry counter before examining the entry path.
Reject when the entry counter exceeds the frozen archive-entry limit.
Normalize only a single leading './' path component for comparison; do not collapse parent, repeated, or other path components.
Select the first normalized path exactly equal to 'package/package.json'; ignore all other paths.
Reject a selected manifest whose declared or observed body exceeds the frozen manifest-byte limit.
Parse selected manifest bytes with an independent JSON parser/model shape; malformed JSON is INVALID_MANIFEST_JSON.
If no selected manifest is reached before logical end, return MISSING_MANIFEST.
Track independently generated decompressed-byte accounting and return DECOMPRESSED_LIMIT if the frozen scan budget is crossed before a terminal manifest result.
models.input_model: Ordered logical tar-entry descriptors plus compressed/decompressed byte accounting and synthetic manifest bytes.
models.output_model: One of ACCEPT_MANIFEST(entry_index, manifest_digest), MISSING_MANIFEST, MANIFEST_TOO_LARGE, ENTRY_LIMIT, DECOMPRESSED_LIMIT, INVALID_MANIFEST_JSON.

algorithm: Require roots to equal their lexicographically sorted unique copy.
Require exact package (name, version) identities to be unique and packages to be ordered lexicographically by (name, version).
Require resolved edges to equal their lexicographically sorted unique copy over all edge fields.
Build a model-owned map from exact package identity to package dependency map.
For every edge, require source and target exact package identities to exist, a non-empty declared constraint, and a source manifest dependency with the same dependency name and exact constraint text.

Parse only the model's restricted generated semantic-version grammar and evaluate the generated constraint against target version with a separately implemented comparator; generated cases outside that grammar are not in the validity domain.
Require at most one resolved target for each (source name, source version, dependency name).
Require exactly one resolved edge for every source manifest dependency.
Canonical constructor expectation is sorted/deduplicated roots, sorted packages, and sorted/deduplicated edges before validation.
models.input_model: Primitive roots, package records, dependency maps, and resolved-edge records decoded into model-owned structs.
models.output_model: VALID_CANONICAL or one stable invalidity class from the property configuration.

algorithm: Reject an empty input.
If allow_dot is true and the complete input is '.', accept the empty component list.
Replace every backslash with '/'.
Reject if normalized text starts with '/', starts with '//', or byte index 1 is ':'.
Split on '/'; reject any empty component, '.', or '..'.
Accept all remaining components without filesystem access or canonicalization and emit them joined by '/'.
models.input_model: UTF-8 path string and allow_dot boolean.
models.output_model: ACCEPT with normalized slash-separated components, or REJECT with a stable lexical reason.

algorithm: Remove the fragment beginning at the first '#'; evaluate only the preceding target text.
Reject if target text is empty.
Split target text at the final '|' when present; reject empty URL or empty explicit version.
Without an explicit version, collect all candidates whose URL exactly equals the parsed URL.
With an explicit version, collect only candidates whose URL and optional version exactly equal the parsed values; an unversioned candidate does not satisfy an explicit version.
Sort and deduplicate candidate identities.
Classify zero candidates as EXTERNAL, one as RESOLVED, and more than one as AMBIGUOUS.
models.input_model: Canonical string plus a model-owned map URL -> sorted candidate identities each carrying optional canonical version.
models.output_model: PARSE_ERROR_EMPTY_TARGET, PARSE_ERROR_EMPTY_VERSION, EXTERNAL, RESOLVED(identity), or AMBIGUOUS(sorted_unique_identities).

algorithm: Canonicalize package nodes by total tuple order over exact identity then source.
Canonicalize artifact nodes by total tuple order over exact identity and semantic fields, removing exact duplicates.
Canonicalize dependency edges by total tuple order and remove exact duplicates.
Canonicalize canonical-reference edges by total tuple order and remove exact duplicates; candidate vectors inside each edge are independently sorted and deduplicated.
Derive unsupported resource types as the sorted set difference between present types and the frozen supported set {CodeSystem, StructureDefinition, ValueSet}.
Compare canonical graph tuples across generated input permutations; insertion order must not alter the tuple.
models.input_model: Model-owned package nodes, artifact nodes, package dependency edges, canonical-reference edges, and root-request sequences.
models.output_model: Canonical graph tuple with sorted package nodes, sorted unique artifact/edge sets, preserved canonical root sequence, and deterministic coverage type sets.

algorithm: Build each fingerprint key from schema, ruleset, rule_id, severity, direction, source_kind, resource, before/after filenames, view, element_id, field, before, and after; recursively sort JSON object keys while preserving array order.
Encode the model key as deterministic UTF-8 JSON using the model serializer contract and compute lowercase SHA-256.
Reject duplicate current, baseline, or suppression fingerprints in inputs that require uniqueness.
For each current fingerprint, SUPPRESSED takes precedence over BASELINE, which takes precedence over NEW.
Unused suppressions are the sorted suppression-key set difference from current fingerprints.
Direction BOTH selects all; PRODUCER selects only producer findings; CONSUMER selects only consumer findings.
Fail-on BREAKING blocks only selected NEW breaking findings; RISKY blocks selected NEW breaking or risky findings; NONE blocks none.

Suppressed and baseline findings never contribute to new blocking counts; final pass is true exactly when blocking_findings is zero. Unused suppressions remain separately retained evidence and do not alter the pass boolean.
models.input_model: Model-owned compatibility finding records, ruleset, direction/fail-on policy, baseline finding set, and suppression records keyed by fingerprint.
models.output_model: Fingerprints, NEW/BASELINE/SUPPRESSED dispositions, unused suppression set, selected/severity counters, blocking counter, and final passed boolean.
